episode_title: Websites Go Offline, Protests in France, Netflix Downsizes
script_en: Websites Go Offline, Protests in France, Netflix Downsizes.
AI discovered a vulnerability in part of the internet's architecture, called PHP2SHELL.
Security researchers rushed to fix it, but the news leaked and hackers have swooped in.
France deploys hordes of police as another wave of protests begin.
Netflix is regrouping after the release of its latest quarterly earnings this week.
